title: Continuation and missing work
summary: Continue QUIC by strengthening provider semantics, interoperability and current-baseline qualification without bypassing the common socket authority.
invariants: Requalify source changes against the current common SocketProvider baseline before changing the declared compatibility line.
Add explicit QUIC stream directionality and stream-limit/backpressure evidence before claiming complete multiplex semantics.
Add external COTS QUIC interoperability evidence; loopback alone is not cross-implementation proof.
Add connection migration/path-change support only behind the provider boundary and preserve address/object authority.
Do not move HTTP/3 semantics into the socket provider; HTTP/3 is a separate protocol consumer of QUIC.
